steps.title: Maintenance & Evolution

applications.title: Our Digital Products
applications.intro: At AFRIKYIA, we develop practical digital solutions tailored to the needs of individuals, professionals, and organizations, combining ease of use and innovation.

diftar.name: دفتر
diftar.desc: A digital ledger platform designed for payment agents, enabling the recording of cash-in and cash-out transactions, monitoring cash box liquidity, calculating commissions and profits, and generating daily closing reports, with offline functionality and multi-device synchronization.

sanad.name: سند
sanad.desc: An application for organizing bank transfer receipts, automatically extracting data from images, categorizing financial transactions, and generating structured, auditable, and exportable statements.

elbet.name: البت
elbet.desc: A digital platform connecting clients with folk and classical Arabic poets to commission custom poems, "Atlaa", and "Guivane".

badila.name: بديلة
badila.desc: A digital platform enabling users to directly barter and exchange goods and items cashless, through listing items, proposing exchanges, and communicating between parties.

works.title: Digital Projects & Deployed Systems
works.desc: A curated selection of software platforms, management systems, and institutional digital portals engineered by our team.
